title: Chapter 195
text:
Han Xiao had seen the impact of the information on the forum, and it was just as he had expected.

He had once again tricked the Germinal Organization, and they did not even know who was messing with him or what went wrong.

Sneaking around and doing bad things made him feel good all over.

However, the faction recommendation letter was not popular, which surprised Han Xiao a little. He thought about it and knew the reason. This was determined by the current economic situation of the players. Although the guilds could gather 250,000, the risk was not small. If the recommendation letter was not effective, it would greatly slow down their development.

This meant that the price he set was too high at this time. When the average wealth of the players increased, the risk of buying the recommendation letter would decrease. Only then would the guilds try to buy it.

"With this price, it will take a long time before the first person to try it appears." Han Xiao bit his nails and fell into deep thought. The best way is to lower the price … but that is impossible! It does not exist!

"Then, I can use the promotion strategy and give some other benefits in the recommendation letter."

The first thing that came to Han Xiao's mind was the favorability reward. For example, he would give some favorability points when buying the recommendation letter. Favorability points were used as a prerequisite for high-level equipment in the shop. This was part of the profit chain.

He felt that it was not appropriate to give favorability points as the highest favorability points were only 100. The higher the favorability points, the more he would cherish them. He would only give 10 favorability points to normal players at most, and it would not exceed that. He could not let the players get it easily.

If he used it on the recommendation letter, it would not be attractive if it was only one or two favorability points. If it was too much, it would be disadvantageous to him.

"Then, how about giving them equipment?" As soon as this idea popped up, Han Xiao pushed it back down. He would not do such a thing. If he wanted to be a qualified businessman, he definitely could not be so conscientious.

Recently, he had merged many new blueprints, but there were no finished products, so he could not sell them.

As for the potions, now was not a good time to sell them. The market for some potions with percentage bonuses would only expand when the players' levels were higher. Professional players who wanted to compete were the best target customers.

Just as he was thinking, an unexpected notification appeared on the interface.

[Source of the Grouper Plague] completed.

Requirement 1: Find the source of the plague. Completed.

Requirement 2: Stop the spread of the plague. Completed.

Requirement 3: Cure all the plague victims. Incomplete.

You have received 60000 EXP. + 400 Black Pine Settlement Favorability.

Han Xiao was stunned.

This mission was left to Mad Blade, Furious Sword, and Pork Bun. They had completed it!

"As expected of the person I've taken a fancy to." Han Xiao laughed. Mad Blade and Pork Bun were both around Level 15. This quest was a little difficult for them. Although they did not complete it perfectly, it was still a pleasant surprise. After all, Han Xiao had not interfered with this quest from the beginning. This meant that the reward was completely free!

Wait a minute!

Han Xiao's eyes lit up.

He was suddenly inspired and thought of another way to promote the recommendation letter!

"Mad Blade, nice one!"

Han Xiao chuckled. This mission was completed in time and reminded him at the critical moment. It was simply like sending charcoal in the snow or an urn in the fire.

At this time, the players in the novice village were learning [Energy Training Technique] one after another. At the same time, they were all amazed by the astronomical price of the recommendation letter. The string of zeros made them dizzy.

Han Xiao suddenly said loudly, "The torrent of the times carries everyone forward. The truth that has been buried in dust will always be forgotten by those who cannot stop moving forward. I need some trustworthy people to help me with something."

As he said that, he wrote new missions according to the five mission objectives of the hidden main storyline [New Era — Origin]. [The End of the Lingering Ones], [The Key to the Lost], [The Dusty Past], [The Mysterious Prisoner], and [Fellow Traveler].

[New Era — Origin] was too cumbersome. If Han Xiao were to do it, it would waste a lot of time. Furthermore, this was only the first round.

Han Xiao decided to split the mission objectives and share them with the players. This way, he could save time and reap the benefits. Mad Blade's success proved his idea. It turned out that he could also receive rewards when the players completed the mission.

Just like an evil capitalist, he used benefits to attract others to work for him. However, he still earned the most.

Furthermore, Han Xiao also indicated that this was a 'main storyline mission'. This could further increase his status among the players.

"An NPC who gave out the main storyline mission, damn, that must be an important person!" This was probably what the players would think.

When the players saw these missions, they were shocked. Then, it turned into ecstasy. It was as if they had reached a climax in an instant.

"Main storyline mission!"

"Oh my god! This is another main storyline! "

"There are so many rewards!"

"Quickly accept the mission!"

However, the players found that the mission was gray and could not be accepted. They were shocked.

"Why can't I accept the mission? Why can't I accept it? "

Their doubts were quickly solved. They noticed that the mission actually had a prerequisite — to buy a recommendation letter!

That's right, it was that black-hearted!

The players were speechless. What was there to play? 250,000, who the f * ck could afford it!

Looking at the players whose emotions were fluctuating and whose expressions were like impotence and constipation, Han Xiao secretly smiled. Due to the limit, his' main storyline mission 'could only be given out in limited amounts. He could only choose to go the elite route. The target he wanted to attract was the professional players. Since the professional players had the support of the big guilds, he could use them to promote the recommendation letter and bundle the sales.

Want the main storyline mission? Sure, buy my recommendation letter.

Don't want to spend money? Then how can you become stronger?

Professional players were willing to use any means to grow. They would never give up on the main storyline mission.

Furthermore, Han Xiao had another reason for doing this. Normal players were not good enough and might cause him to fail the mission. Professional players, on the other hand, were more skilled and had the support of the big guilds. They had helpers when doing missions, so naturally, they were more reliable.

The rarer something was, the more valuable it was. He also added a key message in the mission introduction, saying that there was a chance to gain Black Phantom's favor and that there was a chance to unlock his' hidden storyline 'by accepting the mission.

The examples of Mad Blade, Pork Bun, and Maple Moon were not attractive enough. There were very few professional players who accepted the mission. Perhaps they thought that triggering the hidden storyline depended on luck, so they did not pay much attention to it.

Han Xiao decided to give them a strong dose of medicine and let the professional players see a channel that had a higher chance of triggering Black Phantom's' hidden storyline '.

"Great strategy this time. This is a stone … so many birds." Grandfather Han was very satisfied.

Little guys, I don't believe that you won't take the bait!

…

The forum had the function of a chat room. At this time, a passworded chat room was flooded with people, and the notifications kept ringing.

Jade Green Sky has entered the chat room.

[Jupiter has entered the chat room.]

Morning Snow Twilight Frost has entered the chat room.

I Cry Your Mother Collapses has entered the chat room.

More than ten people entered the chat room. They were all famous guild leaders in China. They knew each other and had a small circle.

"Is everyone here?" Drizzle River's guild leader, Green Sky Rain was the first to speak.

I Cry Your Mother Collapses said, "Not yet."

This sentence had a double meaning. Nine Doors guild's guild leader, Three Three Nine, asked, "Where's Old Qi? Can you help him?"

"Forget it. That kid spams the screen every day. Don't even think about talking about business with him around," Chrysanthemum Floor's guild leader, Cowherd Star, said.

"Who booked the room? What business are we talking about? "Jupiter asked.

Jade Green Sky interrupted, "Yo, isn't this one of the top esports players? I heard that Protoss has not been doing well recently. Trash guild leader, when are you going to be fired? I'll go to your club and set off firecrackers to celebrate. Jupiter."

Jupiter: "F * ck off."

Morning Snow Twilight Frost sent a funny smiley face.

I Cry Your Mother Collapses said, "Green Sky Rain, the pillar of Thunderstorm, Rainy Jiang, has been very active recently. Can you help me get an autograph?"

Green Sky Rain: "Three thousand for one, no deal."

"F * ck, are you robbing me? Don't you have any awareness of being a good guild leader?"

Cowherd Star interrupted, "My autograph is free, do you want it?"

I Cry Your Mother Collapses said, "F * ck off, your autograph is too hard to wipe my ass with. If it's Yaoyao's autograph, I might consider it. Yaoyao Seven Strings Bell."

"Don't try to please me, I didn't come in." Cowherd Star was not happy.

Morning Snow Twilight Frost sent a funny smiley face.

Jupiter: "Stop joking, let's talk about business. I'm very busy."

Jade Green Sky: "Forget it, you're just a mascot."

Jupiter shouted, "Get out of here!"

I Cry Your Mother Collapses said, "Okay, I'll pull the topic back. You all saw the post on the forum, right? It's about the main storyline mission of Black Phantom."

"Yes, I saw it. What are you trying to say?"

"Let's pool the money and let the pro players take on the main storyline mission of Black Phantom."

"You want to share the risk, right? But only one person can take on the mission. Why don't we pool the money ourselves?"

"No, what I mean is, we can cooperate and suggest that the pro players form a team to complete the mission. It's a healthy competition."

Jade Green Sky: "That's not a bad idea, but I need to ask for the team's opinion first."

Cowherd Star: "If I join, the club will definitely have no objections."

Three Three Gets Nine: "I get both, smiley/"

Jade Green Sky said, "Aha, I remember now. The pro players of the Temple of God are all in the Southern Continent, right? We won't be able to meet Black Phantom anymore. You can't play with us Jupiter, quickly kick him out. This guy is now a spy sent to gather intelligence."

Jupiter: "Spicy skin …"

[Jupiter has left the chat room.]
